note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. The only contest was in Hilltown; the other divisions were uncontested and are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (Newry Reporter, 9 June 1955, p. 5). Carrickcrossan, Glen, Mayo and Rathfriland North and South had no nomination; their retiring members are named in column 7 of the notice as deemed re-elected (page image read, round2-down 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Clonallon' to Clonallan (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1925-69 name the DED Clonallan; the rounds were filed as Clonallon (1927, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1946, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1964, 1967); Clonallion (1939). This round was filed as 'Clonallon', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (clonallon) answers with a redirect to this one.
